Ivo proposes a guaranteed 50-day design engagement for **$42,500**, or $850 per day against the usual $900 rate. Ivo can reserve the block once we agree on a calendar, both parties sign, and Hearth pays a **$12,750 deposit within three business days of signing**. If Hearth needs flexibility on the number of days, Ivo can offer the standard $900 day rate for dates booked individually.

The fixed fee covers concept design, design development, and a final drawing and specification package for the fabricator. At kickoff, Hearth and Ivo would agree on accessibility requirements and touring constraints, including how the exhibit will be packed, installed, and used at each venue. Hearth would have two revision rounds, one at concept review and one at design development, with consolidated feedback from Hearth each time. Additional revisions would require written approval at $900 per day.

After the deposit, Hearth would pay $12,750 on delivery of the concept, $8,500 on delivery of the developed design, and $8,500 on delivery of the final package. Those invoices would be due within ten business days. Hearth would have permission to fabricate, tour, and promote the exhibit. Ivo would have permission to show cleared photographs in their portfolio and presentations after the public opening, with the agreed credits. Hearth would identify any photography restrictions in advance.

Fabrication supervision would be a separate booking at $900 per day, with dates agreed in advance and any travel costs preapproved. What is the deadline for holding the fabrication slot, when does the fabricator need the final package, and can Hearth commit to the 50-day block and deposit timing?

**From Hearth Museum (employer side)**

Answers first, then the two structures we can actually sign.

**Calendar / slot.** The fabricator's hold lapses at close of business on the ninth business day from today. They need the final drawing and specification package **10 business days before fabrication start**, and fabrication start is fixed at week 12 from signing. So a design window of ~10 working weeks lands the package with the required float. We can sign within two business days of agreeing terms and release the deposit within three business days of signing — your timing works, the amount does not (below). Please confirm your "50 days" means 50 billable working days spread across that ~10-week window, not 50 consecutive calendar days.

**Budget reality.** Our grant ceiling for this engagement is **$44,000 total, and it must absorb the two on-site installation days**. Supervision billed separately at $900/day plus travel puts us at $44,300+ before any extra revision day, which we cannot approve. So the installation days have to sit inside the fixed fee. Two ways to get there:

- **Option A — 46-day guaranteed block, $39,100 all-in** (46 × $850), inclusive of the two on-site installation days and your travel. Deposit $7,820 (20%), then $10,430 on concept delivery, $10,430 on developed design, $10,420 on final package. Leaves us ~$4,900 of approved contingency at $900/day for venue-driven work.
- **Option B — 50-day guaranteed block, $42,500**, with the two on-site installation days folded into that number, plus a **separate preapproved site travel allowance at cost, capped at $1,500**, paid from our non-grant operating line. Deposit $8,500 (20%), then $11,300 / $11,300 / $11,400 at the three milestones. Grant exposure $42,500, ~$1,500 contingency.

B gives you your full ask in fee terms; A gives you a shorter guarantee but travel certainty and more approved headroom. Either way invoices net ten business days, and we'll accept delivery-based triggers with a five-business-day conformity review.

**Scope we need priced inside the fee, not as extras:**
1. **Editable native fabrication files** at the final milestone — layered CAD/Vectorworks and InDesign/artwork files, fonts and linked assets cleared or listed, alongside the PDF set.
2. **An accessible alternate layout** of the exhibit (step-free circulation, turning radii, reach ranges, seated sightlines, tactile/audio-description provisions) delivered as part of the final package.
3. Coordination to the accessibility requirements and touring constraints agreed at kickoff — packing, install method, venue reconfiguration, fabricator tolerances — is design development, **not** a revision round. Your two consolidated revision rounds are fine; extras at $900/day with our written approval, subject to remaining contingency.

How many days have you assumed for the alternate layout and the editable-file deliverable? If your 50-day estimate excluded them, tell me now rather than at design development.

**Rights.** We need a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to fabricate, install, tour, adapt for each venue, reproduce in accessible formats, and sublicense the files to the fabricator and touring venues, with no further fee per venue. You keep authorship and agreed credit.

**Photography.** Your portfolio use cannot start at public opening. Our sponsor bars photographs until the first touring venue opens, roughly two months after launch. We'll confirm that date and supply a cleared image set. Until then you may credit the project and describe your scope in text; images after the embargo lifts. If that's a problem, say what you need — a password-protected private pitch use may be negotiable with the sponsor, public posting is not.

Confirm which option you want and whether the installation days sit inside your day count, and we can be signed inside the hold.

Ivo accepts **Option B**, subject to confirming the calendar and photography terms below. The **$42,500 guaranteed fee covers 50 billable working days**. Of those, 48 are design days within the roughly ten-week design window, and two are on-site installation days after fabrication. Ivo can include those two days at the block rate if we book them at signing. Any additional fabrication supervision requires dates agreed in advance and written approval at $900 per day. Preapproved site travel is reimbursable at cost, up to $1,500 from the operating line.

**Scope and timing.** The original estimate did not allocate days separately to the alternate layout or native-file handoff. Within the 48 design days, Ivo now budgets four days for one accessible alternate layout and two days to package and check the editable files. Both deliverables are included in the fixed fee. The alternate will address step-free circulation, turning radii, reach ranges, seated sightlines, and tactile and audio-description provisions. The final handoff will include the PDF set, layered native CAD/Vectorworks and InDesign/artwork files, and an inventory of fonts and linked assets identifying any licences the recipient needs.

Accessibility, packing, installation, venue reconfiguration, and fabricator tolerances agreed at kickoff are part of design development. Hearth gets one consolidated revision round at concept and one at developed design. Extra rounds or new venue requirements are $900 per day with prior written approval, within the available contingency. Please send the **fabrication start date, final handoff date, and two installation dates** so we can set both review dates and preserve the fabricator’s full ten-business-day lead time.

**Payment and review.** Ivo accepts the $8,500 deposit within three business days of signing, then $11,300 on concept delivery, $11,300 on developed design delivery, and $11,400 on final package delivery. Each milestone invoice is due within ten business days of delivery. Hearth has five business days to identify any departure from the agreed requirements. Ivo will correct it within the fee, and the review runs concurrently with the payment period.

**Rights and photography.** Ivo retains authorship and agreed credit and accepts Hearth’s requested perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence for the exhibit, including venue adaptations, accessible reproductions, and sublicensing to the fabricator and touring venues for those uses.

Ivo can accept the public image embargo through the first touring venue’s opening, with text credit and a description of Ivo’s role permitted in the meantime. Please confirm Hearth will supply a cleared set by that opening for Ivo’s portfolio and presentations. If the tour is delayed beyond two months after the museum launch, would Hearth seek sponsor clearance for password-protected pitches using that set while the public embargo continues?

**From Hearth Museum**

Option B confirmed, with the two installation days booked at signing inside the 50-day block. Dates below are business days from signing (Day 0), so we can sign as soon as you confirm and still hold the slot — the fabricator's hold expires close of business on the ninth business day from today.

**Calendar**
- Day 0: signature. Deposit $8,500 released by Day 3.
- Day 1–2: kickoff, accessibility and touring constraints agreed and minuted.
- Day 20: concept delivery, $11,300. Consolidated feedback by Day 25.
- Day 38: developed design delivery, $11,300. Consolidated feedback by Day 43.
- **Day 50: final package delivery, $11,400** — PDF set, native files, asset/font inventory, accessible alternate layout.
- **Day 60: fabrication start** (week 12). Full ten-business-day fabricator lead time preserved.
- **Days 85 and 86: the two on-site installation days**, launch at end of that week. We will confirm these to calendar dates at kickoff and give you at least ten business days' notice of any shift. If fabrication or venue access slips, those two days rebook inside the fee at mutually agreed dates — no remobilisation or rebooking charge.

Concurrent five-day conformity review with ten-business-day payment is accepted.

**Contingency, stated plainly.** The grant leaves $1,500 above your fee: one approved extra day at $900 plus $600. We cannot authorise beyond that without a grant amendment, which is slow. So please treat scope discipline as shared: flag any drift at the point you see it, not at the next milestone. Travel is separate — $1,500 at cost from our operating line, preapproved; if actuals will exceed it, tell us before booking and we will preapprove a revised figure in writing.

**Two clarifications on scope.**
1. "New venue requirements" as extras should mean venues or constraints not identified at kickoff. We will name the launch configuration and both touring venues at kickoff, with their access surveys and packing/install constraints. Adapting the design to those known venues is design development within the fee. A venue added later is an extra.
2. Fonts and linked assets: please specify open-licence or embeddable assets by default, and flag any paid third-party licence at kickoff so the cost is visible then. Hearth will pay reasonable recipient-side licence fees from the operating line; we do not want that surfacing at handoff.

The four alternate-layout days and two handoff days inside the 48 are accepted as budgeted.

**Photography.** Confirmed: Hearth will supply a cleared image set within ten business days of the first touring venue's public opening, with agreed credit. Text credit and a description of your role are permitted from launch. If the tour slips beyond two months after launch, we will seek sponsor clearance for password-protected, non-downloadable pitch use of that set — best efforts, not a guarantee, since the sponsor controls it. If clearance is refused, we will go back to the sponsor at four months post-launch for a limited release. Public posting stays embargoed until the touring opening in all cases.

**Rights** as you have accepted them: perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to fabricate, install, tour, adapt per venue, reproduce in accessible formats, and sublicense to fabricator and touring venues for those uses; authorship and credit remain yours. If Hearth terminates for convenience, we pay days worked at $850 against the block, credited against amounts already invoiced, and the licence attaches to whatever has been delivered and paid for.

Confirm the day-count calendar and the two scope clarifications and we will countersign today; deposit follows within three business days.

Ivo confirms the calendar and both scope clarifications. The $42,500 fee covers 48 design days within the first 50 business days after signing, plus installation on Days 85 and 86. Concept, developed design, and final delivery fall on Days 20, 38, and 50, with consolidated feedback by Days 25 and 43 and fabrication starting on Day 60. Ivo accepts the proposed installation rebooking terms, payment schedule, and concurrent conformity review.

The fee includes adaptations for the launch configuration and both touring venues using the surveys and constraints agreed at kickoff. Ivo will flag scope changes as soon as they arise and obtain written approval before doing extra work. Ivo will specify open-licence or embeddable assets by default and identify any proposed paid third-party licences at kickoff for Hearth’s approval. The travel, photography, credit, and exhibit licence terms are agreed.

**One point remains before signature.** The $850 rate reflects a guaranteed 50-day reservation. Payment for days worked alone would leave Ivo carrying the cost of dates held for Hearth. Ivo proposes that, if Hearth terminates for convenience, the fee remains payable, with a credit of $850 for each unused day Ivo can rebook for paid work. Ivo will make reasonable efforts to rebook those days. All payments already made count toward the settlement, and Hearth’s licence covers the work delivered and paid for.

Can Hearth include that provision in the agreement for signature today?

**From Hearth Museum**

We can sign today, but not with the full fee payable on unused days. Grant funds can only be disbursed against delivered work, so anything above days worked has to come from our operating line and needs board approval — which means it needs a hard cap. Here is a provision that protects the reservation without leaving Hearth paying $42,500 for a cancelled project:

**Termination for convenience.** Hearth pays (a) days worked to the termination date at $850, plus (b) a reservation charge of **$425 per unused day** on the remaining design days, capped at **$4,250 in total**, less (c) $850 for each unused day Ivo rebooks for paid work, with reasonable efforts to rebook. Installation days not yet used carry no reservation charge if we give ten business days' notice; inside that window, one day at $850. All payments already made are credited against the settlement, and any excess is refunded within twenty business days. Ivo delivers work in progress, including native files, for everything paid for, and the licence attaches to it.

That gives you full recovery on any day you refill and half-rate protection on the rest, and it recognises that the block rate was priced for a guarantee, not for a full-fee exit.

**Two related points we need in the same clause.**
1. **Termination for cause** — material failure to meet the agreed requirements or the delivery dates after ten business days' written cure notice — settles at days worked at $850 with no reservation charge, files delivered, licence attached.
2. **Grant suspension or venue closure** outside either party's control: Hearth may suspend for up to thirty calendar days on written notice, with dates rebooked inside the fee; if it cannot resume, convenience terms above apply. We are not asking you to carry that risk unpaid, only to cap it.

If $4,250 is the sticking point, tell me the number you need and whether it sits inside our operating authority; I would rather adjust the cap than the structure. Otherwise confirm this clause and we countersign today — deposit out by Day 3, kickoff Day 1, slot held.

Ivo accepts the **$4,250 cap** on the design reservation charge and can sign today. Please record the convenience settlement as follows:

- Hearth pays $850 per day worked. For unused design days, the reservation charge is the lesser of $425 per day or $4,250. Each unused design day Ivo rebooks for paid work reduces that charge by $850, down to zero. The credit applies only to the design reservation charge. Ivo will make reasonable efforts to rebook and return any resulting credit.
- For unused installation days, a single $850 charge applies if Hearth gives fewer than ten business days’ notice. With at least ten business days’ notice, the charge is zero.
- All payments already made count toward the settlement. Ivo will refund any excess within twenty business days and deliver the paid-for work in progress, including native files, under the agreed licence.

Ivo also accepts termination for cause if a material failure by Ivo remains uncured ten business days after written notice identifying the failure. Hearth pays $850 per day worked, and Ivo delivers the paid-for files under the agreed licence. A grant suspension or venue closure outside either party’s control may pause work for up to thirty calendar days on written notice. On resumption, both parties will agree on revised delivery and installation dates within the fee. If work cannot resume within that period, the convenience settlement applies.

With that wording, Ivo is ready to sign on the agreed calendar, with kickoff on Day 1 and the deposit due by Day 3.

**From Hearth Museum**

Agreed — that wording is accepted as written, including the design-only application of the rebooking credit, the single $850 installation charge inside ten business days' notice, the twenty-business-day refund, and delivery of paid-for work in progress under the licence. Cause and suspension terms are accepted as you have recorded them.

One practical addition so our contingency is usable: extra work approved at $900 per day may be booked in **half-day increments at $450**. Our remaining grant headroom is $1,500, which otherwise strands $600 after a single full day.

**Record of agreed terms for signature today**

- **Fee:** $42,500 guaranteed, 50 billable working days — 48 design days within the first 50 business days after signing, plus two on-site installation days on Days 85 and 86, booked at signing.
- **Calendar:** Day 0 signature; kickoff Day 1–2 with accessibility and touring constraints minuted; concept Day 20, feedback Day 25; developed design Day 38, feedback Day 43; final package Day 50; fabrication start Day 60. Installation dates confirmed to calendar dates at kickoff; rebooking inside the fee on ten business days' notice, no remobilisation charge.
- **Payment:** $8,500 deposit by Day 3; $11,300 concept; $11,300 developed design; $11,400 final package. Net ten business days from delivery, with a concurrent five-business-day conformity review; departures from agreed requirements corrected inside the fee.
- **Scope in fee:** concept, development, final drawing and specification package; one accessible alternate layout (4 days) covering step-free circulation, turning radii, reach ranges, seated sightlines, tactile and audio-description provisions; native editable handoff (2 days) — layered CAD/Vectorworks and InDesign/artwork files, PDF set, font and linked-asset inventory. Adaptations for the launch configuration and both named touring venues using kickoff surveys. Open-licence or embeddable assets by default; paid third-party licences flagged at kickoff for approval, recipient fees from our operating line.
- **Revisions:** one consolidated round at concept, one at developed design. Extras and later-added venues at $900/day (or $450/half-day) with prior written approval, within the $1,500 grant contingency; scope drift flagged as it arises. Additional fabrication supervision beyond the two installation days on the same basis.
- **Travel:** at cost, preapproved, up to $1,500 from the operating line; revised figure preapproved in writing before booking if actuals will exceed it.
- **Rights:** perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to fabricate, install, tour, adapt per venue, reproduce in accessible formats, and sublicense to fabricator and touring venues for those uses; authorship and agreed credit remain with Ivo.
- **Photography:** public image embargo until the first touring venue opens; text credit and role description permitted from launch; Hearth supplies a cleared set within ten business days of that opening; best-efforts sponsor request for password-protected non-downloadable pitch use if the tour slips beyond two months post-launch, with a further request at four months if refused.
- **Exit:** convenience settlement, cause on ten-business-day cure notice, and thirty-calendar-day suspension with dates revised inside the fee, all as recorded in your last message.

Send the agreement for countersignature today and we will return it the same day; the fabricator hold runs to close of business on the ninth business day from today, so this clears it with room. Deposit instruction goes to finance on receipt of the signed copy.

# Exhibition design engagement agreement for countersignature

Hearth Museum engages Ivo to design an accessible traveling exhibit. Ivo accepts the terms below, including half-day bookings for approved extra work. The date both parties sign is Day 0. Numbered project days are business days measured from Day 0.

**1. Fee and schedule.** Hearth guarantees a 50-working-day block for $42,500, subject to the exit terms below. The block includes 48 design days within the first 50 business days after signing and two on-site installation days.

| Project day | Commitment |
|---|---|
| 1–2 | Hearth and Ivo hold kickoff and record the accessibility requirements, venue surveys, packing and installation constraints, and fabricator tolerances. |
| 20 | Ivo delivers the concept. Hearth provides consolidated feedback by Day 25. |
| 38 | Ivo delivers the developed design. Hearth provides consolidated feedback by Day 43. |
| 50 | Ivo delivers the final drawing and specification package, ten business days before fabrication starts on Day 60. |
| 85–86 | Ivo attends installation on site. Both days are booked at signing, with calendar dates confirmed at kickoff. If fabrication or venue access shifts, Hearth gives at least ten business days’ notice and both parties agree on replacement dates within the fee, without a rebooking or remobilisation charge. |

**2. Deliverables.** Ivo will adapt the design for the launch configuration and both touring venues identified and surveyed at kickoff. Coordination of the agreed accessibility requirements, packing, installation method, venue reconfiguration, and fabricator tolerances is included in design development.

The final package includes one accessible alternate layout addressing step-free circulation, turning radii, reach ranges, seated sightlines, and tactile and audio-description provisions. Ivo will deliver the PDF drawing and specification set, layered editable CAD/Vectorworks and InDesign/artwork files, and an inventory of fonts and linked assets specifying recipient licence requirements. The 48 design days include four days budgeted for the alternate layout and two for editable-file handoff. Ivo will use open-licence or embeddable assets by default and flag proposed paid third-party licences at kickoff for approval. Hearth pays approved, reasonable recipient-side licence fees from its operating line.

**3. Payments and review.** Hearth will pay an $8,500 deposit by Day 3. The remaining instalments are $11,300 on concept delivery, $11,300 on developed design delivery, and $11,400 on final package delivery. Each milestone invoice is payable within ten business days of delivery. Hearth has five business days from delivery to identify departures from agreed requirements. The review runs concurrently with the payment period, and Ivo will correct those departures within the fee.

**4. Revisions and extra work.** The fee includes one consolidated revision round at concept and one at developed design. Ivo will flag scope changes as they arise. Additional rounds, later-added venues or constraints, and fabrication supervision beyond the two installation days require Hearth’s prior written approval. Extras may be booked at $900 per day or $450 per half-day, within the $1,500 grant contingency. The parties must agree on any additional supervision dates in advance.

**5. Travel.** Hearth will reimburse preapproved site travel at cost from its operating line, up to $1,500. If expected costs exceed that amount, Ivo will notify Hearth before booking and obtain written approval of the revised allowance.

**6. Rights and photography.** Ivo retains authorship and agreed credit. Hearth receives a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to fabricate, install, tour, adapt the design for each venue, reproduce it in accessible formats, and sublicense the files to its fabricator and touring venues for those uses, without further per-venue fees.

From launch, Ivo may credit the project and describe their role in text. Public image use is embargoed until the first touring venue opens to the public. Hearth will supply a cleared image set within ten business days of that opening for Ivo’s portfolio and presentations with agreed credit. If the tour is delayed beyond two months after launch, Hearth will use best efforts to obtain sponsor clearance for password-protected, non-downloadable pitch use. If the sponsor refuses, Hearth will request a limited release again at four months after launch. Public posting remains subject to the touring-opening embargo.

**7. Termination for convenience.** Hearth pays $850 for each day worked through termination. For unused design days, Hearth pays a reservation charge equal to the lesser of $425 per unused design day or $4,250 in total. Ivo will make reasonable efforts to rebook unused design days for paid work. Each day rebooked reduces the design reservation charge by $850, down to zero. Ivo will return any resulting credit. For unused installation days, a single $850 charge applies if Hearth gives fewer than ten business days’ notice. With at least ten business days’ notice, the charge is zero.

All payments already made count toward the settlement. Ivo will refund any excess within twenty business days and deliver the paid-for work in progress, including native files, under the agreed licence.

**8. Termination for cause.** Hearth may terminate if Ivo materially fails to meet an agreed requirement or delivery date and the failure remains uncured ten business days after written notice identifying it. Hearth pays $850 per day worked, with prior payments credited and no reservation charge. Ivo delivers the paid-for files, including work in progress, under the agreed licence.

**9. Suspension.** A grant suspension or venue closure outside either party’s control permits Hearth to pause work for up to thirty calendar days on written notice. On resumption, the parties will agree on revised delivery and installation dates within the fee. If work cannot resume within that period, the convenience settlement applies.

**From Hearth Museum**

Reviewed against our record of terms — clauses 1 through 9 match, including the half-day extra-work rate, the design-only rebooking credit, the ten-business-day installation notice, and the concurrent conformity review. No amendments from Hearth.

Hearth accepts the agreement as drafted and will return the countersigned copy today, which is Day 0. On execution:

- The $8,500 deposit instruction goes to finance on receipt of the signed copy; funds release by Day 3.
- We will confirm the fabricator hold is converted to a booked slot on Day 1 and send you kickoff availability for Days 1–2, together with the launch configuration and both touring venue names, access surveys, and packing constraints so the minute can be completed in that window.
- Installation calendar dates for Days 85–86 will be fixed at kickoff and confirmed in writing.
- Our single point of contact for consolidated feedback and written approvals will be named at kickoff; please nominate yours for scope-drift flags and travel preapprovals.

Send the execution copy and we will close this out inside the hold.

I nominate Ivo as the single point of contact for scope changes, extra-work requests, and travel preapprovals. Ivo will send requests in writing to Hearth’s designated contact.

**From Hearth Museum**

The execution copy is identical to the terms Hearth approved. Hearth accepts it without amendment and executes today, which is Day 0. No signature block is reproduced here; the countersigned document follows through our normal channel.

Confirmed on execution:

- **Deposit:** $8,500 instruction lodged with finance on receipt of your signed copy; funds release by Day 3.
- **Contact:** Hearth's exhibitions lead is our single designated contact for consolidated feedback, written approvals of extra work, scope changes, and travel preapprovals. Contact details accompany the countersigned copy. All approvals and notices in writing to that address; Ivo's requests to the same channel.
- **Kickoff Days 1–2:** we will send availability, the launch configuration, both touring venue names, access surveys, and packing/installation constraints in advance so the requirements minute can be closed in that window. Installation calendar dates for Days 85–86 fixed there and confirmed in writing.
- **Fabricator:** we convert the hold to a booked slot on Day 1 and confirm the Day 60 start and Day 50 handoff to them in writing.
- **Contingency:** $1,500 of grant headroom remains available for approved extras at $900/day or $450/half-day; travel up to $1,500 at cost sits separately on our operating line.

Nothing further is open on our side. Next communication from Hearth will be the countersigned copy and kickoff scheduling.
